summary: Unified the system's memory architecture and deployment automation while optimizing FastAPI performance. Integrated high-performance vector storage (sqlite-vec, binary quantization) with robust CI/CD workflows, and resolved event-loop blocking bottlenecks through asynchronous optimization and standardized commit-linting.
key_learnings: Binary quantization and sqlite-vec facilitate high-performance vector storage with minimal overhead.
Quantitative evaluation (RAGAS-lite) is essential to detect signal loss during memory compression.
Synchronous I/O and CPU-bound tasks in async routes must be offloaded to prevent Uvicorn event loop stalls.
System agility relies on balancing robust concurrency/CI/CD workflows with automated enforcement of technical standards.
Automating versioning requires strict commit schemas at the point of origin to ensure deterministic releases.
